description: A shell script for testing Git configurations related to email addresses, commits, rebasing, and author/committer info, including setup, failure cases, and override scenarios.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs the provided commands.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the given command fails.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with specified message.

methods.name: sane_unset
methods.description: Unsets environment variables related to Git author/committer info.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Runs cleanup commands after a test.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
